Harry Potter’s snowy owl has always been unusually intelligent — but there may be a reason for that. Today we're diving into one of our wildest Harry Potter theories yet: that Hedwig was actually an Animagus secretly tasked with watching over Harry.

And once you start looking at the evidence — her strange behavior, her connection to Dumbledore, the Animagus registry, Nicolas and Perenelle Flamel, and the exact timing of Hedwig's death — this theory gets WAY more convincing than it has any right to be.
